Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

help noun and verb

also aid, give aid, assist, assistance, is that the way you help me?, can you help me?, come to the aid of, go to the aid of, come to the rescue

classical

Traupman 327

auxilium, auxiliī n.

noun, second declension

Other words

  • adjuvō, adjuvāre, adjūvī, adjūtum — help someone

    verb, first conjugation · classical

  • succurrō, succurrere, succurrī, succursum — come to help, run to the aid of

    verb, third conjugation, with the dative · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. succurrō II; Traupman 184, 192; Traupman 327; Traupman 322

  • juvō, juvāre, jūvī, jūtum — help, aid

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 327

Examples

  • Vīsne auxilium?

    Do you want help?composed

  • Vīsne ut tē adjuvem?

    Do you want me to help you?composed

  • Istōcine pactō mē adjūtās?

    Is that the way you help me?Plaut. Ps. 1.1.81 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 111

  • Potesne mihi succurrere?

    Can you help me?Traupman 192

  • Istōcine pactō mē adjuvās?

    Is that the way you help me?Traupman 404

See also well done, please.
